pinDescription: Loss of desire after having children isn't just exhaustion—hormones, sleep debt, and mental load all play a role. If scheduling sex feels forced, there are other approaches that work with your biology and your life. Get the full breakdown of what's driving postpartum low libido and what actually helps.
